method.operator_error: max(abs(A-B))/max(1,max(abs(B))) after stated coordinate/wrench normalization; not an entrywise relative bound.
method.normalization: q: translation/chord and spatial rotation; qdot: U/chord; qddot: (U/chord)^2; Gamma: U*chord; Gammadot: U^2. Force: q_infinity*chord*span; moment: force*chord.
method.fluid: Independent wind-aligned horseshoes, geodesic motion, virtual-power nodal transfer, lift, Cm, profile drag, circulation-rate lift, apparent inertia/pitch rate, empirical lag and gravity. Own physical bound omitted in force-point and beam-axis apparent-rate field. Adaptive vortex quadrature and independent apparent kinetic-energy matrix.
method.hybrid: Independently reconstructed fluid/gravity with retained audited production static mechanics and real mass; quadratic polynomial eigenproblem. This control still depends on production mechanics.
method.continuum: Independent nonlinear spatial-rod integration with exact rank-three compliance and distributed real inertia, actual offsets and coupled bending. Independently recomputed fluid/gravity loads and circulation at each equilibrium. Local coupled characteristic roots and physical mode shapes; no production matrices or imports.
method.gates: Original fixed fluid gates retained. Independent base residual <1e-10, mode equation error <1e-8, backward error <1e-9, shape MAC >0.9 and relative FD/ODE pole change <1e-6. Local boundary center growth <1e-5 /s with computed opposite-sign endpoints.
method.source_state: Saved production geometry and modes provide initial guesses and local-root targets. Authoritative independent state files retain only recomputed pose/circulation; unused original loads are not relabeled.
